No release-metadata/API endpoint or by-id lookup is mentioned; only the general 'nothing about it may be learned' confidentiality scope.
Asset listing/detail, asset names and identifiers are never mentioned; covered only by the general property that nothing about unpublished work may be learned.
Only the abstract rule that permission in one repository is not permission over another's material; the legacy cutoff, stored owning repo and address-supplied repo are not described.
Coupled legacy/unlinked-attachment values are not named or described; only the blanket 'Everything that works today keeps working exactly as today' covers them.
